cause_quote: #176001 created readLocalWorkspaceReviewBase with `if (!worktree || worktree.removedAt !== undefined || worktree.ownerKind !== "session" || ...) { throw new Error("Local workspace review owner changed"); }`, folding a removed or missing worktree into the owner-mismatch error.
user_saw: Opening Review for an old session whose worktree had been cleaned up showed "Local workspace review owner changed" with no way to recover.
summary: Splits the removed or missing worktree case out of the owner-changed check in readLocalWorkspaceReviewBase, throwing guidance to use Restore in Settings > Worktrees, and checks the registry even when no review-base row exists.
reasoning: local-workspace-review.ts has a single commit before the fix, 1d71aef2b129 (#176001), which created the file with the combined removal/owner-mismatch condition that produced the misleading error, so the defect shipped with the code. It is mostly a wrong diagnosis and missing recovery step rather than a broken review (the worktree really is gone), hence medium confidence; the fix also stops a missing review-base row from skipping the removal check.
